items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: It was Fess's original thing. I didn't create it as such. But I helped make that record.

ctx.x: And I helped organize it into a beginning, middle, and end, and like that. Contributed. Cleaned up. Clarified some of the words. Mm-hmm. Do you have a credit on there? Do you have a? I used to be co-writer.

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: It was my idea to carry as much business as I could to Cosmo because I figured he would look out for my interests if I helped him with his, you know.

ctx.x: I think so, yeah. Oh, now there was a studio in the Gacho building. Yeah. I know there was.

It was my idea to carry as much business as I could to Cosmo because I figured he would look out for my interests if I helped him with his, you know. Right. So all the talent and everything that I was scouting, I would bring it to the J&M studio.
